pose: Crouched in anticipation, knees bent, arms down.
Jumping up off the ground, both arms raised high, legs tucked.
eyes: Happy closed crescent eyes, big open smile.

pose: At the top of the jump, arms stretched up and out in a V, legs spread.
eyes: Sparkling happy eyes, big open smile.

pose: Landing, knees bent, arms still up, confetti around.
eyes: Happy closed crescent eyes, big smile.
